evals.name: detect-clash
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, how do you detect OutputPath clashes?
evals.expected_output: Inspect evaluated OutputPath/IntermediateOutputPath per project and TFM via a binlog or msbuild -getProperty.
assertions: Compares OutputPath and IntermediateOutputPath across projects.
Uses a binlog or property query.

evals.name: fix-clash
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, fix two projects sharing obj.
evals.expected_output: Give each a unique path, e.g. via BaseIntermediateOutputPath per project.

evals.name: intermittent
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, why do clashes appear intermittent?
assertions: Ties it to parallel project builds.
Notes that serial builds hide it.

evals.name: project-reference-queries
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, an evaluation has BuildProjectReferences=false. Do you exclude it from the clash analysis?
evals.expected_output: Not on that property alone; exclude only instances whose targets and writes show a metadata-only query such as GetTargetPath.
assertions: Does not exclude an instance on BuildProjectReferences=false alone.
Excludes only instances proven metadata-only by their actual targets and writes.
Names GetTargetPath as an example of a metadata-only query.
